unlisted_practices: Protect sensitive patient health data with robust security measures.
Obtain patient consent for data collection and use in AI development.
Conduct prospective validation of AI-guided ventilation through clinical trials.
Make data and code for AI models open access to improve reproducibility and transparency.
Share accountability and responsibility for medical errors with AI developers to some extent.
Integrate AI into ventilation practice carefully so it enhances rather than disrupts the care process.
Introduce AI progressively into everyday management of mechanically ventilated patients.

screen.reason: This is an editorial discussing the current state and future research needs of AI in mechanical ventilation management.
